WITH transaction_sentiment AS (
  SELECT
    t.transreg,
    t.ordertypedist,
    s.shortintrt,
    s.optvolrt
  FROM transactionrecord AS t
  INNER JOIN sentimentandfundamentals AS s
    ON s.transref = t.transreg
),
transaction_averages AS (
  SELECT
    transreg,
    ordertypedist,
    AVG(shortintrt) AS avg_short_interest_days_to_cover,
    AVG(optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio
  FROM transaction_sentiment
  GROUP BY transreg, ordertypedist
),
order_type_averages AS (
  SELECT
    ordertypedist,
    AVG(shortintrt) AS order_type_avg_short_interest
  FROM transaction_sentiment
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
)
SELECT
  ta.transreg AS transaction_reference,
  ta.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix,
  ta.avg_short_interest_days_to_cover,
  ta.avg_option_volume_ratio,
  ta.avg_short_interest_days_to_cover / NULLIF(ota.order_type_avg_short_interest, 0) AS short_interest_ratio
FROM transaction_averages AS ta
LEFT JOIN order_type_averages AS ota
  ON ta.ordertypedist = ota.ordertypedist
ORDER BY short_interest_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
